verdict.rationale: Storing passkeys is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. Authy's own feature docs describe only 2FA tokens: TOTP QR capture, sync, backup and app protection. The only passkey mention (authy-docs-2) belongs to Twilio Verify, a separate developer API for verifying users. That is a different product's capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app stores passkeys and signs me into websites and apps with them, not just TOTP codes
